_comment: Example Step 4 (COA Analysis & Wargaming) artifact for Operation NORTHERN SHIELD
wargame_method: BELT (by phase) with targeted AVENUE_IN_DEPTH for the River Lena crossing

arc_table.friendly_action: JFC NORTH pre-positions 3x BDE combat sets at EDL positions NB4421-NB5528; establishes SHORAD umbrella covering Sector Alpha; conducts ISR saturation along NAI-1 through NAI-6 using MQ-9 and JSTARS
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Country X 3rd Combined Arms Army moves 2x MRD forward to assembly areas at NB6035-NB6540; activates GPS jamming from Gridref NC7033; conducts cyber reconnaissance against friendly C2 networks
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: J6 deploys NAVWAR-resilient PNT backup across all BDEs; CYBER_EW executes defensive hunt operations to detect intrusion; J2 confirms enemy force disposition validates PIR-01
arc_table.notes: Shaping phase achieves 80% BDA coverage; enemy disposition tracking confirmed via SIGINT correlated with IMINT from NAI-2

arc_table.friendly_action: JFC NORTH activates air defense umbrella (3x Patriot batteries + NASAMS); moves reserve BDE to blocking position at River Lena crossing (NB5528); broadcasts strategic messaging via IO to Country X population
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Country X launches 24x MRBM strikes against 4 key airfields and 2 logistics nodes; 1st Tank Army begins forward movement toward River Lena; adversary conducts widespread DDoS against military .mil domains
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Patriot/NASAMS intercept 19/24 missiles (79%); 3 airfields degraded to 60% capacity, 1 logistics node destroyed - J4 activates alternate LOC via Highway 7; CYBER_EW deflects DDoS, isolates compromised network segment within 90 minutes
arc_table.notes: Critical finding: loss of Logistics Node ECHO requires immediate TPFDD adjustment; triggers DP-01 evaluation

arc_table.friendly_action: Main effort: 12th Mech BDE defends River Lena crossing with 2x MBN and 1x EN BN in prepared positions; fires from 2x FA BDE mass on EA LION (NB5830-NB6032); CAS on-call from 4x F-35 sorties/hour
arc_table.enemy_reaction: 3rd Combined Arms Army commits 2x MRD in echelon attack across River Lena; employs 40x smoke generators to obscure crossing; 1st Tank Army feints along northern axis at NC8834 with 1x TD to fix reserves
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Counter-battery radar detects enemy arty positions; MLRS suppresses 3/4 enemy arty BNs within 45 min; 12th Mech BDE withdraws to alternate positions after EA LION attrition reaches 30% threshold; J2 identifies northern feint via SIGINT intercept of 1st TA orders (resolves PIR-02)
arc_table.notes: Enemy crossing attempt at River Lena repelled with 40% enemy casualties; friendly losses: 2x MBN at 75% strength. DP-02 triggered: commit reserve?

arc_table.friendly_action: Reserve BDE commits through 12th Mech BDE's sector to exploit enemy culmination; 2x SOF teams conduct deep strike on enemy LOC bridges at NB7545 and NB8050; combined air-ground operation captures Obj HAMMER (NB6540)
arc_table.enemy_reaction: 3rd Combined Arms Army, now at 55% strength, attempts orderly withdrawal to pre-war positions; commits final reserve (1x independent MRB) to delay; activates scorched-earth destruction of civilian infrastructure along withdrawal route
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: IO publicizes enemy atrocities for strategic effect; 3x UAV surveillance tracks withdrawal routes; fires plan shifts to interdiction of retreat corridors; SOF confirms bridge denial at NB7545 - traps 1x MRD south of river
arc_table.notes: Enemy 3rd CAA rendered combat-ineffective (below 50%). Transition criteria for Phase IV met at D+10.

arc_table.friendly_action: JFC NORTH establishes security zones along restored EDL; transitions from combat ops to stability ops; begins battle damage assessment and humanitarian corridor establishment
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Remaining Country X forces consolidate north of EDL; irregular forces/stay-behind cells conduct sabotage against LOCs; Country X seeks diplomatic off-ramp via third-party mediator
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: J3 establishes 4x security patrols per sector; CYBER_EW conducts persistent monitoring for stay-behind C2; J5 coordinates with political advisors on ceasefire terms; J9 liaises with HN and NGOs for civilian support
arc_table.notes: Transition to Phase IV requires NAC political approval (external dependency). DP-06 addresses ceasefire acceptance terms.

decision_points.trigger: Loss of >=2 logistics nodes or primary LOC (Highway 3/Rail Line 7) severed for >12 hours
decision_points.decision: Activate alternate LOC via Highway 7 and request TPFDD emergency re-routing through southern port
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan ALPHA: Shift main supply route to Highway 7; J4 activates pre-positioned stocks at Alternate Supply Point FOXTROT; accept 48-hr delay in reinforcement flow
decision_points.sequel: If Highway 7 also interdicted, request strategic airlift through Country Z international airport

decision_points.trigger: Enemy commits 2nd echelon (1st Tank Army main body) across River Lena OR 12th Mech BDE combat power drops below 60%
decision_points.decision: Commit reserve BDE to defend or counterattack at River Lena
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan BRAVO: If enemy crosses in strength, reserve conducts counterattack to restore River Lena defense line; if 12th Mech holds, reserve repositions to exploit enemy culmination
decision_points.sequel: Sequel: If counterattack succeeds, transition to Phase III offensive ops within 48 hours

decision_points.trigger: Air superiority not achieved within 96 hours (72-hr target +24 buffer) OR loss of >=3 fighter squadrons
decision_points.decision: Shift to air denial posture and redistribute CAS allocation from 4 to 2 sorties/hr
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan CHARLIE: Increase reliance on surface fires (MLRS/HIMARS); request theater-level air reinforcement; shift air defense to point defense of critical assets only
decision_points.sequel: If air denial sustained >5 days, request strategic bomber support from out-of-theater assets

decision_points.trigger: Country X employs CBRN agents or credible intelligence indicates imminent CBRN employment
decision_points.decision: Implement CBRN defense posture MOPP-4 in affected sectors; escalate through NAC for political response options
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan DELTA: Affected units assume MOPP-4 (accept 30% reduction in combat tempo); activate decontamination assets from theater reserve; J5 coordinates NAC emergency session for response authorization
decision_points.sequel: Based on NAC guidance, execute proportional response ranging from diplomatic demarche to expanded targeting of Country X strategic assets

decision_points.trigger: Cyber attack degrades friendly C2 network to <40% operational capacity for >4 hours OR loss of SATCOM connectivity
decision_points.decision: Activate degraded-mode C2 procedures using HF backup nets and courier system
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan ECHO: Shift to mission-type orders with 48-hr execution windows; decentralize fire control to BDE level; J6 activates CYBER_EW counter-offensive to restore network
decision_points.sequel: If C2 restored within 12 hours, resume centralized ops; if not, maintain degraded mode and request theater cyber reinforcement

decision_points.trigger: Country X signals willingness for ceasefire OR enemy forces withdraw behind pre-war boundary line
decision_points.decision: Accept ceasefire terms and transition to Phase IV stability operations, or continue offensive to achieve additional objectives
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan FOXTROT: If ceasefire accepted, establish contact line and security zone; begin battle handover to follow-on force; initiate redeployment planning
decision_points.sequel: Sequel: Post-ceasefire, transition to Phase V (Enable Civil Authority) with NATO stabilization force

strengths: Exploits prepared defensive terrain at River Lena - forces enemy into costly river crossing under fire
Maintains a coherent reserve capable of counterattack once enemy culmination is identified
Cyber/EW integration throughout all phases degrades enemy C2 and enables friendly information advantage
Clear transition criteria between phases prevent premature commitment of forces
LOC redundancy (Highway 3 + Highway 7) provides logistics resilience
weaknesses: Heavy reliance on air superiority within 72 hours - if delayed, ground forces face significant attrition
Single reserve BDE creates all-or-nothing commitment decision at DP-02
Northern axis at NC8834 thinly covered - vulnerable to more than a feint if enemy commits 1st TA main body there
Counterattack phase assumes enemy culmination at River Lena - if enemy secures bridgehead in strength, Phase III timing slips
Stability phase depends on NAC political decisions (external dependency outside CDR control)

updated_risk.description: COA-1 overall risk: Enemy secures River Lena crossing before reserve can counterattack, forcing costly urban fighting in Sector Alpha
updated_risk.narrative: Wargaming revealed that if enemy achieves simultaneous crossing at 2+ points along River Lena, 12th Mech BDE cannot cover all sectors. 40% enemy casualty estimate assumes single crossing point. Multi-axis crossing reduces attrition to ~25% and may compromise the defense.
updated_risk.mitigation: Pre-position engineer obstacles at 3 alternate crossing sites; emplace FASCAM minefields at NB5225 and NB5831; assign 1x attack helicopter squadron for rapid response to secondary crossings

modifications: Add FASCAM obstacle plan for alternate River Lena crossing sites NB5225 and NB5831
Assign 1x AH-64 squadron as quick reaction force for secondary crossing detection
Increase SHORAD coverage in Phase II from 3x to 4x batteries to account for increased MRBM threat
Pre-position Class V stocks for 72-hr intensive combat at River Lena positions (J4 action)

arc_table.friendly_action: Establish ISR coverage with emphasis on enemy assembly areas; position guard force (1x BDE) forward along EDL; main body (2x BDE) positioned 30km behind EDL in covered assembly areas for mobile counterattack
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Country X advances 3rd CAA toward EDL; fails to detect main body positioning due to OPSEC measures; focuses ISR and targeting on forward guard force
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Guard force conducts deception operations to appear as main defense; J6 operates dummy C2 emissions from forward positions; J2 confirms enemy deception take through SIGINT analysis
arc_table.notes: Shaping success depends on OPSEC for main body positioning - if compromised, enemy will avoid engagement area

arc_table.friendly_action: Guard force conducts delay operations along 3 successive delay lines, attriting enemy lead elements 15-20% per line; main body remains concealed; fires mass on pre-planned engagement areas
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Enemy 3rd CAA pushes through guard force delays; enemy commits 2nd echelon to maintain tempo; advancing columns extend logistics tail 40km beyond start line
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: J2 tracks enemy culmination indicators (logistics consumption rate, vehicle breakdown rate, C2 response times); guard force withdraws through main body positions; engineer obstacles channel enemy into EA TIGER
arc_table.notes: Guard force accepts 30% attrition in delay - must maintain unit cohesion for passage of lines

arc_table.friendly_action: Main body (2x BDE) executes mobile counterattack into enemy flank at EA TIGER; concentrated fires from 3x FA BDE plus MLRS; simultaneous SOF raids on enemy logistics hubs at NB7040 and NB7545
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Enemy 3rd CAA, overextended and depleted by delays, struggles to reorient to flank threat; commits final reserve to block counterattack; 1st TA attempts to reinforce but logistics tail interdicted by SOF
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Exploit success by pushing through disorganized enemy formations; CAS concentrates on enemy reserve commitment; continue SOF interdiction of enemy reinforcement routes
arc_table.notes: Critical assumption: enemy culmination occurs before D+3. If enemy maintains combat power, counterattack may stall.

arc_table.friendly_action: Exploitation force pursues retreating enemy to restore EDL; establish blocking positions to prevent enemy reorganization; fires shift to interdiction of retreat routes
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Disorganized enemy withdrawal; rearguard actions by 1x MRB; stay-behind units attempt to interdict friendly LOCs
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Lead element maintains contact; follow-on forces clear stay-behind elements; J5 coordinates ceasefire terms once EDL restored
arc_table.notes: Pursuit culminates at EDL - no crossing of international boundary without NAC authorization

decision_points.trigger: Guard force attrition exceeds 50% before reaching 2nd delay line OR enemy bypasses guard force entirely
decision_points.decision: Abort delay plan and commit main body to hasty defense or accelerate counterattack timing
decision_points.branch: If guard force collapses early: main body conducts hasty defense at EA TIGER rather than mobile counterattack; accept defensive posture until reinforcement
decision_points.sequel: Request theater reserve to reconstitute mobile counterattack capability

decision_points.trigger: J2 assesses enemy has NOT culminated by D+3 (logistics flow sustained, <15% attrition in lead echelon)
decision_points.decision: Delay counterattack by 48 hours and continue guard force delay, or execute counterattack on schedule against non-culminated enemy
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan GOLF: Extend delay phase; commit additional fires to accelerate enemy attrition; SOF prioritize logistics interdiction over direct action
decision_points.sequel: If enemy still not culminated by D+5, transition to deliberate defense (fallback to COA-1 posture)

decision_points.trigger: Enemy detects main body assembly areas before counterattack launch
decision_points.decision: Execute immediate spoiling attack to disrupt enemy preparations, or reposition main body to alternate assembly area (48-hr delay)
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan HOTEL: Immediate attack from current positions accepting reduced coordination; or move to AA-BRAVO and attack from alternate axis
decision_points.sequel: If surprise lost, accept increased casualties in counterattack; request additional CAS and SEAD to compensate

decision_points.trigger: Counterattack at EA TIGER fails to break through enemy defense (main body stalled >24 hours with <10% penetration)
decision_points.decision: Reinforce counterattack with theater reserve or transition to deliberate defense and prepare new attack
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan INDIA: Request theater reserve BDE; shift main effort to alternate penetration point 15km south; conduct deliberate breach with engineer support
decision_points.sequel: If second attempt fails, transition to defense-in-depth along current line of contact; operational pause for 72 hours

strengths: Preserves combat power in initial phase - avoids static attrition at River Lena
Exploits enemy overextension through operational maneuver rather than positional defense
Deception plan draws enemy ISR/targeting to guard force, protecting main body
Higher potential for decisive result - can destroy enemy combat power rather than just repel crossing
weaknesses: Extremely high risk - cedes terrain initially, which may be politically unacceptable to NAC
Guard force accepts very high attrition (30-50%) in delay role - morale and cohesion risk
Counterattack timing depends on accurate enemy culmination assessment - intelligence failure cascades to operational failure
If enemy does not culminate as expected, main body is committed to a counterattack against a superior force
OPSEC for main body is a single point of failure - if detected, entire COA collapses
Ceding ground to enemy risks civilian population centers behind the EDL

updated_risk.description: COA-2 overall risk: Enemy does not culminate as assumed, resulting in a failed counterattack against a numerically superior force while having already ceded the EDL defensive terrain
updated_risk.narrative: Wargaming revealed that COA-2's success depends entirely on accurate enemy culmination prediction. If the enemy sustains logistics better than estimated or commits both 3rd CAA and 1st TA simultaneously, the mobile counterattack encounters a non-culminated force with combat superiority. Recovery from a failed counterattack while having ceded prepared positions is extremely difficult.
updated_risk.mitigation: Maintain fallback positions at River Lena as contingency (requires engineering effort that may reveal defensive plan); establish clear culmination indicators with J2 confidence thresholds before committing; maintain DP-02 as hard go/no-go gate

modifications: Establish clear J2 culmination criteria: enemy must show >=2 of 5 indicators (logistics convoy disruption >40%, vehicle breakdown rate >15%, C2 response time >2x baseline, lead echelon attrition >20%, reserve uncommitted)
Pre-position fallback defensive positions at River Lena as contingency (accept OPSEC risk)
Increase SOF teams from 2 to 4 for logistics interdiction to accelerate enemy culmination
Add dedicated IO deception cell to manage guard force deception narrative

arc_table.friendly_action: All 3x BDEs occupy prepared positions along EDL with interlocking fields of fire; engineer effort concentrates on obstacle belts and survivability positions; pre-planned fires registered on all likely crossing points and avenues of approach
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Country X 3rd CAA recognizes strong forward defense through ISR; adjusts attack plan to concentrate force at perceived weak point (junction between 12th and 15th BDEs at NB5830); masses artillery for preparatory fires
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: J2 detects enemy concentration via JSTARS and UAV; JFC NORTH shifts 1x MBN from reserve to reinforce junction; pre-planned spoiling attack preparations accelerated; CYBER_EW targets enemy artillery C2 networks
arc_table.notes: Forward defense is detected by enemy - no deception advantage. But prepared positions provide protection advantage.

arc_table.phase: Phase I - Defend Forward (D-Day to D+3)
arc_table.friendly_action: All 3 BDEs defend in sector along EDL; concentrated fires on crossing points destroy 30-40% of first echelon during approach; spoiling attack force (1x mech BN task force) launches limited attack into enemy assembly area at NB6540 on D+1
arc_table.enemy_reaction: 3rd CAA absorbs spoiling attack casualties but maintains momentum; shifts main attack to northern sector to avoid spoiling attack area; commits 2nd echelon by D+2 to replace losses
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Spoiling attack TF withdraws to friendly lines on D+2; northern BDE (at NC8834) conducts fighting withdrawal to successive positions; fires shift north to support; request air interdiction of 2nd echelon approach routes
arc_table.notes: Spoiling attack disrupts enemy timetable by 36 hours but costs 1x MBN TF at 60% strength. Enemy main effort shifts north - validates contingency planning.

arc_table.phase: Phase II - Attrite and Hold (D+3 to D+10)
arc_table.friendly_action: Defend along EDL with all available forces; reconstitute spoiling attack TF; mass fires on enemy penetrations; request theater reinforcement to replace losses
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Enemy achieves local penetration in northern sector (5km); commits 1st TA lead elements to exploit penetration; intensifies air/missile attacks on friendly rear areas
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Seal penetration with reserve BN and prepared secondary positions; MLRS fires on enemy exploitation force; air interdiction of 1st TA approach routes delays full commitment by 72 hours
arc_table.notes: Penetration contained but not eliminated. Forward defense consuming forces faster than replaceable. DP-03 critical.

arc_table.friendly_action: Once theater reinforcement arrives (1x BDE, D+8), launch deliberate counterattack to eliminate northern penetration and restore EDL
arc_table.enemy_reaction: Weakened enemy formations defend in place; 1st TA attempts to reinforce but logistics exhausted
arc_table.friendly_counteraction: Systematic reduction of enemy penetration using combined arms; restoration of EDL by D+15; transition to security operations
arc_table.notes: Counterattack success depends on theater reinforcement timeline - external dependency

decision_points.trigger: Spoiling attack TF attrition exceeds 40% before reaching Obj SPIKE (NB6540) OR enemy detects and counters spoiling attack with >1 BDE response
decision_points.decision: Abort spoiling attack and withdraw TF to EDL defensive positions
decision_points.branch: Cancel spoiling attack; accept that enemy timetable is not disrupted; reinforce main defense line with returning TF assets
decision_points.sequel: If spoiling attack aborted, enemy attacks on original timeline - adjust fire plan accordingly

decision_points.trigger: Any BDE sector breached with >regiment-size enemy force crossing EDL AND friendly BDE unable to restore with organic assets
decision_points.decision: Commit theater reserve or accept penetration and defend on secondary positions
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan JULIET: Commit reserve MBN to counterattack penetration; accept risk in other sectors; or withdraw affected BDE to Phase Line BRAVO (10km behind EDL) and defend in depth
decision_points.sequel: If penetration not sealed within 48 hours, execute delay to Phase Line CHARLIE and request emergency theater reinforcement

decision_points.trigger: Overall JFC NORTH combat power drops below 65% OR 2+ BDEs below 50% combat effectiveness
decision_points.decision: Request emergency theater reinforcement and/or transition to economy of force defense on reduced frontage
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan KILO: Consolidate remaining forces on 2/3 of EDL frontage; accept risk on undefended sector; emplace maximum obstacles in gap; request theater reserve BDE deployment within 72 hours
decision_points.sequel: If theater reserve not available within 96 hours, execute fighting withdrawal to Phase Line DELTA (30km behind EDL) to trade space for time

decision_points.trigger: Theater reinforcement (1x BDE) confirmed available AND enemy 3rd CAA assessed at <60% combat effectiveness
decision_points.decision: Launch deliberate counterattack to restore EDL or maintain defense and use reinforcement to reconstitute
decision_points.branch: Branch Plan LIMA: Counterattack with reinforcement BDE supported by reconstituted forces; or use reinforcement to relieve most attrited BDE and continue defense
decision_points.sequel: Post-counterattack, transition to Phase IV stability operations once EDL fully restored

strengths: Defends all terrain from the start - politically acceptable to NAC allies
Prepared positions provide maximum protection and force multiplication
Spoiling attack disrupts enemy timetable and imposes early costs
Simpler C2 than mobile defense - all units in known positions with pre-planned fires
Does not depend on complex intelligence assessment (culmination prediction) for success
weaknesses: Static defense across full frontage spreads forces thin - no strong reserve
Spoiling attack consumes a battalion task force that cannot be easily replaced
If enemy achieves penetration, limited ability to counterattack without theater reinforcement
Attrition-based approach - friendly forces consumed at potentially unsustainable rate
Counterattack phase dependent on external theater reinforcement timeline (outside CDR control)
Enemy can choose point of main effort against thinly-spread defense

updated_risk.description: COA-3 overall risk: Forward defense spreads forces too thin, allowing enemy to achieve decisive penetration before theater reinforcement arrives, resulting in gradual collapse of the defense
updated_risk.narrative: Wargaming showed that COA-3 creates a race between enemy penetration and friendly reinforcement. Defending the full EDL with 3x BDEs against a 3-army enemy force results in no meaningful reserve. The spoiling attack, while disruptive, further depletes available forces. If theater reinforcement is delayed beyond D+10, the defense becomes unsustainable. The COA lacks operational-level flexibility.
updated_risk.mitigation: Negotiate pre-deployment of theater reserve BDE to reduce reinforcement timeline from D+8 to D+3; reduce spoiling attack scope from BN TF to company-level raids; designate one BDE sector as economy of force to create larger reserve

modifications: Reduce spoiling attack from BN TF to 2x company-level raids to preserve combat power
Pre-coordinate theater reserve deployment to reduce timeline from D+8 to D+5
Designate northern sector as economy of force with reinforced screening force to create 1x MBN reserve
Add pre-planned withdrawal routes and rally points for each BDE in case of sector breach

updated_ccirs.text: Is Country X preparing CBRN employment? Indicators: NBC unit movement to forward assembly areas, decontamination vehicle staging, increased secure comms from NBC command net
updated_ccirs.indicator: Movement of 3rd CAA NBC regiment from garrison at NC9050 toward forward positions
updated_ccirs.timeliness: Continuous, report within 30 minutes of detection

updated_ccirs.text: What is the current friendly ammunition expenditure rate vs. resupply rate for Class V across all BDEs? Wargaming indicates 72-hr intensive combat at River Lena will consume 200% of normal Class V allocation
updated_ccirs.indicator: Daily Class V status reports from each BDE CSS BN
updated_ccirs.collection_asset: J4 logistics reporting system / BDE S4 reports
updated_ccirs.timeliness: Every 12 hours during Phase II, every 6 hours if expenditure exceeds 150% of planned rate

collection_gaps: No reliable MASINT capability to detect enemy CBRN preparations - gap identified during CBRN branch plan development
Limited HUMINT coverage behind enemy lines for logistics flow assessment - critical for COA-2 culmination prediction
Counter-battery radar coverage has 15km gap between Sector Alpha and Sector Bravo - enemy artillery could operate in dead zone
No persistent ISR coverage of enemy 1st Tank Army assembly areas during nighttime hours (D-3 to D-Day) - JSTARS coverage only 16hrs/day
